open_questions: Depth changes between sectors 27 and 67 (likely detrending/systematics at SNR ~10.7) need additional light curves to confirm consistent depth

Gaia excess_noise_sig 13.49, ruwe 1.214 and rv_amplitude 6.563 +/-0.5619 (rv_log_p -0.00388) imply astrometric/binary motion that could indicate activity or an unseen companion - RV mass measurement needed to rule out stellar companion and confirm planetary mass despite 2.8 Rearth size

dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a 3.998-hour, 1643 ppm dip repeating every 14.3 days with an odd-even match, no secondary, and a size of about 2.8 Earth radii consistent with a small planet on an M-dwarf. The dip looks flat and there are no nearby stars bright enough to mimic it within one pixel, so a blended binary is unlikely. The depth jumped between the two sectors and the star shows mild Gaia and radial-velocity noise, plus only a few shallow transits, so the signal is marginal and the nature is not fully proven yet.
